cases.scenario: Tamper ciphertext byte, tag byte, or AAD; reject wrong-length DEK; reject non-24-hex nonce.
cases.expected: InvalidTag on ciphertext/tag/AAD tamper; ValueError on bad DEK length or malformed nonce

cases.scenario: Feed a 64-hex challenge nonce to is_aes_gcm_nonce_hex24 and a 24-hex AES-GCM nonce to is_challenge_nonce_hex64.
Verify a signature under a different domain, under a different key, and against a tampered payload.
Flip a byte in an inclusion audit-path node; flip a byte in a consistency audit-path node.
cases.expected: reconstructed root no longer equals the genuine committed root

cases.scenario: Change a membership proof's leaf value; flip a byte of a non-membership proof's sibling.
cases.expected: reconstructed root no longer equals the genuine current-map root

cases.scenario: Mutate both projected self-fields (null / different nonempty value); recompute identity from raw (non-projected) canonical bytes instead of projected bytes.
cases.expected: projected identity unchanged by self-field mutation; raw (non-projected) digest/size diverge from the projected identity

cases.scenario: Overwrite with different key material; re-create after destroy; metadata-mismatch collision; readback receipt inspected for leaked raw key material.
cases.expected: KeyAlreadyExists / KeyAlreadyDestroyed / KeyCollision raised as appropriate; receipt mapping never contains wrapped_dek_hex or the raw DEK hex

cases.scenario: Corrupt or missing external inventory row; ACTIVE-bound key with matching vs. attacker-forged metadata_digest.
cases.expected: QUARANTINE_UNKNOWN for corrupt/missing rows and metadata mismatch; RESUME_EXACT only on exact match; DESTROY_UNBOUND count is zero across all quarantined/active cases

cases.scenario: put() a JSON object bearing a plaintext field; put() a malformed non-envelope JSON object; simulate on-disk content swap under an existing blob_id; flip a stored byte then get().
cases.expected: OpaqueViolation on plaintext/malformed JSON; IntegrityError on write-once collision with different bytes and on corrupted read

cases.scenario: Inject a plaintext-named column via ALTER TABLE; replay a stale prev_digest on append_event; inspect append_event's signature for a body parameter; insert a duplicate (workspace_id, artifact_kind, revision_id) tuple under a different artifact_id.
cases.expected: assert_no_plaintext_columns raises LifecycleDbError; append_event raises EventChainError and never writes a row; append_event has no body/text parameter; the hash chain over all surviving rows verifies; sqlite3.IntegrityError on the duplicate tuple

cases.scenario: assert_marker_matches called with an expected_profile that does not match the marker's recorded profile_selection.
